page.layout: One page of running text, with a head and a question heading in the middle. Margin notes stand in the right margin (NB., Ebrietati, refistentia.). Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: dantur: falsuginem enim illam fero permisce-ri testantur, qui crebrius salsis cibis utentes sal-siorem mingunt urinam, & contra. Quamuis NB. haec non à me dicuntur, vel in apertum profe-runtur, ut tansam alicui ministrem aut fenestrā aperiam ad potandum, sed ut aut moderatè bibere omnes assuescant, aut si occasione incidente liberalius & meracius sit bibendum, id fiat citra noxam & incommodum corporis. De Ebrietati Ebrietate autem naturali quadam proprietate refistentia. repugnantibus, inter quæ amygdalas amaras, brassicam, cardamomum, perficorum nucleos, succum foliorum perficæ arboris expressum, absinthii pontici dilutum, & noftrum etiam vulgare absinthium præcipuam obtinuisse laudem reperio, suo dicetur loco & ordine.
main_text.head: QVÆSTIO III. An à potu omninò sit abstinendum intermedio prandii & cœnæ tempore?
main_text.p: HIC vero modeste discedo ab iis, qui quasi prætorio edicto inter prandium & cœnam omnem potum interdicunt, putantes claufum ventriculum potu frigido crudoq; aperiri, coctionemq; interturbari. Ri-gidam nimis hanc in victu præceptionem vix ab uno inter millenos video observari, imo verius dixerim à nullo mortalium.
Quis enim potu omninò abstinere juberet falsuram vel suillæ carnis, vel halecesex muria,

page.notes: The initial H is a large woodcut letter, joined to "IC" as "HIC". The marginal note at the first mention reads "NB." and is set in an ornate italic. The second margin note reads "Ebrietati" and the third "refistentia." (the last letter and the n/u are doubtful, see [?] not used because the form is clear enough). The word "halecesex" is printed without a space. Long s is plain s throughout. The printed "alios-" at the lower right is treated as a catchword. The signature "F 5" is read from the foot of the page.
